recognize_zh: 這是免疫組織化學染色（紅色 AEC 呈色、蘇木紫複染），淋巴組織中成片中至大型細胞呈細胞膜/細胞質紅色陽性；圖上未標示抗體種類，無法單憑此圖判定是哪一群淋巴細胞，也無法確定是否為正常組織。
features: Immunohistochemical stain with red (AEC-type) chromogen and hematoxylin counterstain
Diffuse sheet of medium-to-large lymphoid cells with round to oval vesicular nuclei
Membranous and granular cytoplasmic red staining in the majority of cells
Staining relatively uniform across the field without clear zonation
Antibody not specified; architecture limited at this magnification
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain with a red chromogen on lymphoid tissue shows a diffuse sheet of medium-to-large cells with round to oval nuclei, most of which show membranous and granular cytoplasmic positivity. No clear follicular or zonal pattern is evident in this high-power field. Because the antibody is not specified, the lineage of the positive cells cannot be determined from the image, and a uniformly positive population of larger cells would need to be correlated with the H&E and additional markers before interpreting it as normal (for example, a germinal center) versus a neoplastic infiltrate.

ddx.dx: Reactive germinal center stained with a B-cell marker
ddx.vs: Would be a circumscribed nodule with a surrounding mantle and polarization, and a proliferation marker would show a high but zonated Ki-67.
Shows diffuse architectural effacement on H&E with sheets of large atypical B cells, often with aberrant marker expression.

ddx.dx: Paracortical T-zone stained with a T-cell marker
ddx.vs: Positive cells would be predominantly small lymphocytes admixed with negative interdigitating cells and high endothelial venules.

stain: IHC: red chromogen, antibody not specified
